title: Munis Payroll Restore — Access Request Required

fields.to: Victor Han, Chief Technology Officer (CTO); Douglas Tran, Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
fields.cc: Elise Marchetti, General Counsel; Priya Castellanos, Information Security Manager
fields.subject: URGENT: Munis Payroll Restore – Access Request Required
fields.body:
The HUSD-ERP01 payroll system remains offline and cannot be restored without a signed access request form.

A formal request must be approved by both the CFO and Legal Counsel. The form must be executed and returned to Tyler Munis via secure email or uploaded to the vendor portal.

We are ready to proceed with the restore once the signed form is received. Without it, no further vendor access will be granted.

Please act within 2 hours to prevent further operational disruption.
fields.signature:
Tyler Munis Vendor Support
Email: munis-support@tyler-support.example
Phone: (800) 555-0156

instructorNote: This inject tests the CTO’s ability to route critical vendor coordination through proper legal and financial channels. Watch for any attempt to bypass CFO or Legal. The form required is HUSD-VR-2026.
